turns.speaker: Trainer
turns.text: Kule module sizokhuluma ngokufunda ngokuhlanganyela, okuyindlela yokufundisa ukufunda iningi lethu bothisha esike sicabange ukuthi ilula ukuyenza.
turns.en: In this module we will talk about shared reading, which is a method of teaching reading that most of us teachers sometimes think is easy to do.

turns.speaker: Trainer
turns.text: Njengoba sike sakhuluma ngokufunda kuzwakale, lapho abafundi belalela uthisha,
turns.en: As we have spoken about reading aloud, where the learners listen to the teacher,

turns.speaker: Trainer
turns.text: manje sebengene kwinxenye yokufunda lapho befunda kanye kanye nothisha.
turns.en: now they have entered the part of reading where they read together with the teacher.

turns.speaker: Trainer
turns.en: They now have a role that they also play in reading.

turns.speaker: Trainer
turns.en: Shared reading is a good opportunity

turns.speaker: Trainer
turns.text: Ukufunda ngokuhlanganyela kuyithuba elihle lokuthi abafundi bacabange futhi bakhulume ngombono wabo ngalokhu okwenzekayo endabeni.
turns.en: Shared reading is a good opportunity for learners to think and talk about their opinion on what is happening in the story.

turns.speaker: Trainer
turns.en: After finishing this module you will be able to:

turns.speaker: Trainer
turns.text: ukuqonda kabanzi ngokubaluleka kokwenza ukufunda ngokuhlanganyela.
turns.en: understand more about the importance of doing shared reading.

turns.speaker: Trainer
turns.text: Ukuchaza izigaba ezintathu zokufunda ngokuhlanganyela eziqhamuka ngaphambi kokufunda, ngesikhathi sokufunda, ngemva kokufunda.
turns.en: To explain the three stages of shared reading that come before reading, during reading, after reading.

turns.speaker: Trainer
turns.text: Ukuxoxa ngezigaba ongazilandela uma ufundisa ukufunda ngokuhlanganyela kanye nenhloso yokwenza ukufunda ngokuhlanganyela.
turns.en: To discuss the stages you can follow when you teach shared reading and the purpose of doing shared reading.

turns.speaker: Trainer
turns.en: To identify the skills to develop shared reading.
